edits.new:
The refusal, not-recorded and stale-data states the app story shows read the messages of section 14.

SCR-26 Award has four screen states that this story names and the contract does not carry: the empty state, the loading state, the error state and the no-access state. The messages and field lists of these four states are Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-10516); they belong to RWB-PLT-N001-CON, the edge story that owns the composite route.
